method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING-kind where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (giving the Attorneys-General notice of a special federal matter within the time the Supreme Court directs, s 6(4), (5)(b)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Jurisdiction of Courts (Cross-vesting) Act 1987 (WA), Act No. 68 of 1987, compilation including the Legal Profession Uniform Law Application Act 2022 s 424 (in force 1 July 2022), retrieved 7 September 2026 from the Western Australian Legislation website, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_45308.txt

seat: a party to a civil proceeding, usually the person bringing a claim (plaintiff, applicant or claimant), whose proceeding is in a Western Australian court, the Federal Court, the Family Court or a Supreme Court of another State or Territory and meets cross-vesting: transfer, removal, appeal, applicable law, costs, enforcement (jcxv-claims.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run jcxv-dates.l4 ; l4 run jcxv-claims.l4 ; l4 run jcxv-cases.l4
checks.result: 152 assertions written, 152 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The whole operative Act, from a party's seat. In: s 3 (terms used, including s 3(2)), s 3A, s 4, s 5, s 6, s 6A, s 7, s 8, s 9 (folded into s 4 and s 5), s 10, s 11, s 12, s 13, s 14(2), (3). Out: preamble, s 1, s 2, s 15 (reading down), s 16 (suspension by proclamation), the transitional s 7 of the 1994 amending Act; the Commonwealth Act's 'special federal matter' definition and Schedule (not deposited; asked as facts). Reasons in NOTES.md.
